description: This file contains implementation of hook handling functions in a Git-like version control system, including functions to find hooks, check their existence, run hooks asynchronously, and handle hook options.

methods.name: const char * find_hook(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Locates an executable hook script in the repository's hooks directory, attempting alternative extensions if configured, and provides advice if the hook is not executable.

methods.name: int hook_exists(struct repository * r,const char * name)
methods.description: Checks whether a specific hook exists and is executable by utilizing find_hook.

methods.name: int pick_next_hook(struct child_process * cp,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void ** pp_task_cb UNUSED)
methods.description: Prepares and queues the next hook to be executed in a parallel process.

methods.name: int notify_start_failure(struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cp UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the scenario when starting a hook process fails.

methods.name: int notify_hook_finished(int result,struct strbuf * out UNUSED,void * pp_cb,void * pp_task_cb UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles cleanup and status update after a hook finishes executing.

methods.name: void run_hooks_opt_clear(struct run_hooks_opt * options)
methods.description: Clears environment variables and arguments set in the hook options.

methods.name: int run_hooks_opt(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,struct run_hooks_opt * options)
methods.description: Runs all hooks of a given name with specified options, handling parallel execution and errors.

methods.name: int run_hooks(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name)
methods.description: Convenience function to run hooks with default options.

methods.name: int run_hooks_l(struct repository * r,const char * hook_name,...)
methods.description: Runs hooks with additional arguments specified via variadic parameters.
